The paired divine strength and raised horn are shared, with the community and the expressly royal recipients distinguished.

old_row.relationship: A plea to remember fragile human existence
old_row.rationale: Psalm 88 asks God to remember what the speaker's existence is before questioning whether all humans were created in vain.
